Check Mean Edge Durations Against the Departure Ceiling

Source: R/net.fn.utils.R
check_departure_ceiling.Rd

Stops when a mean edge duration is at or above the departure ceiling and warns when one is at or above 90% of it, for dissolution_coefs().

Usage

check_departure_ceiling(duration, d.rate)

Arguments

duration

Vector of mean edge durations.

d.rate

Departure rate, a single number.

Value

NULL, invisibly.

Details

The ceiling is 1 / (1 - (1 - d.rate)^2), the mean duration at which every partnership ending is a departure; see the Details of dissolution_coefs(). The error and the warning carry the caller's call, so they name dissolution_coefs().
